connector.name: PuckAPI
connector.registryDescription: The hockey data API. Stats, odds, and everything between. REST API and MCP server.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.puckapi.com over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the noahowsh account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
